message: macro `twice` has a rule with more than one `...`
notes: a repeating element absorbs every argument left after the fixed ones (macro-system.md MAC-LANG-16), so a second has nothing defined to absorb and where the split fell would be the expander's guess
help: keep one repeating element per rule; the arguments a second one would take are the ones the first already took

message: macro `shaped` repeats something that is not a plain name
notes: v1 of MAC-LANG-16 binds ONE name to the forms a repeat absorbs. A repeated PATTERN binds each of its binders to a sequence of its own, in lockstep, which is a second thing and is not built
help: repeat a bare binder - `(m T v ...)` - and take the shape apart in the template

message: `v` repeats, and this position takes one form
notes: a template MUST use a repeated binding under an ellipsis of the same depth (macro-system.md MAC-LANG-16): a name bound to a SEQUENCE is many forms, and every position that takes one form needs to be told which
help: write `... ` after it to splice every form it took, or match it with a non-repeating element
